The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Tough. Precise. And built to outlast the competition.

From large acreage to tight residential jobs, Ferris zero-turn mowers are engineered to maximize comfort and productivity. With industry-leading suspension technology and commercial-grade components, the IS600Z is a compact powerhouse built for serious performance.

The new Ferris IS600-48, K19 delivers professional results with a 48” fabricated cutting deck, patented suspension system, and a 19 HP Kawasaki engine. Built to handle tough jobs without sacrificing comfort, it’s the perfect fit for commercial cutters or landowners who demand more.

Features may include:

Commercial Grade Power
Powered by a reliable 19 HP Kawasaki® FT730V engine with V-Twin technology, offering excellent performance and fuel economy.

Suspension System
Ferris patented suspension with front independent shocks and rear coil-over shocks smooth out uneven terrain, reducing operator fatigue and increasing mowing speed.

Fabricated Cutting Deck
A 48″ iCD™ Cutting System with heavy-duty steel construction delivers superior airflow and cutting precision.

Hydro-Gear® Transaxles
Commercial Hydro-Gear® ZT-3200™ drive system for smooth and responsive control even under heavy loads.

Adjustable Cut Height
Quick and easy height-of-cut adjustment from 1.5” – 4.5” in 1/4” increments.

Ergonomic Operator Station
Includes premium seat with armrests and convenient controls to maximize operator comfort.

Fuel Efficiency
5.5-gallon fuel tank for extended mowing time with fewer stops.

Compact Footprint
Ideal for tight spaces and residential or light commercial properties without sacrificing power or durability.
